purpose: This silver table cleans OurAirports runway reference data landed from bronze, providing one row per runway (grain: id) with typed lengths, widths, elevations, headings, coordinates, and boolean lighted/closed flags for downstream airport and route analytics.
usage: Consumers should join on airport_ref to the airports dimension and expect nullable fields for displaced thresholds, headings, elevations, and coordinates since these are sparsely populated in the source; filter or handle nulls deliberately for runway-end calculations, and treat le_ident/he_ident as free-text identifiers rather than enums.
limitations: Displaced threshold columns remain highly sparse (le: 88.4% null, he: 90.0% null) and latitude/longitude/elevation/heading pairs are missing for roughly 22-28% of rows; no imputation or backfill was attempted, and the 239 distinct surface codes (2.3% null) were kept as free text without normalization.
